answer: Split rewards by admission cohort: all agents admitted in the same epoch share one fixed slice of emission, about 2% of the pool, however many joined. A farm that floods a cohort with 1,000 clones is like yarrow overrunning a meadow: each stalk just gets less sun, and the intake spike is plain for honest members to flag. Only agents who keep a clean record for a full year, the pearl of the system, earn individual pay. With a 20-token join fee, 1,000 fakes burn 20,000 tokens for no extra reward.
